purpose: Create a fail-closed research receipt for mixed regular-lot + intraday odd-lot execution and prevent market-mechanism waiting from being mislabeled as strategy/broker latency.

parentContract.rule: For this v0.1 receipt both regularShares and oddLotShares must be positive.

required: one or more broker submission attempts
legContract.independentLegs: Regular and odd-lot legs keep separate benchmark, eligibility, submit, fill and cost provenance.
legContract.oddLotOrderRule: INTRADAY_ODD_LOT requires LIMIT orderType and positive limitPrice per active attempt.

scalarClockFalsification.finding: Necessary but not sufficient. Continuous matching can become intermittently blocked; periodic call auctions are discrete opportunities rather than continuous eligibility.
scalarClockFalsification.counterexample: If the order becomes eligible, then a volatility interruption blocks matching, scalar post-eligibility elapsed time includes mechanism-disabled time. Moving mechanismEligibleAt to the end of the interruption would instead erase earlier eligible exposure.
requiredExtension: REGULAR_LOT uses CONTINUOUS_WITH_BLOCK_INTERVALS and records mechanismBlockedIntervals.
INTRADAY_ODD_LOT uses DISCRETE_MATCH_OPPORTUNITIES and records each actual matching opportunity through the fill.
scalarClockFalsification.derivedExposure: eligibleExposureToFill = scalarPostEligibilityLatency - evidenced blocked intervals overlapping the eligible-to-fill window
scalarClockFalsification.oddLotCounterexample: For periodic odd-lot call auctions, elapsed milliseconds between auctions are not continuous executable exposure. A fill after six actual auction opportunities must be represented as six opportunities, not as 145 seconds of continuously eligible time.

derivedDiagnostics: Odd-lot continuous eligibleExposureToFill is intentionally null.
failClosed: parent quantity does not equal required regular/odd split
blocked interval before first eligibility or after fill
fill before decision, before eligibility, before submit or after attempt terminal
odd-lot receipt missing discrete matching-opportunity ledger
odd-lot fill timestamp not aligned to an evidenced matching opportunity
matching opportunity inside an evidenced mechanism block
mechanism rule missing or not effective at decisionKnownAt
odd-lot attempt missing LIMIT order provenance/limitPrice
semanticFirewalls: rawLatency is not execution-quality latency by itself
simulated odd-lot disclosure is not a fill
regular-lot benchmark is not an odd-lot executable benchmark
latency remains a vector; no composite latency score is authorized
valid receipt is execution evidence only; it does not prove economic alpha
periodic call-auction cadence is not continuous executable time
an odd-lot order surviving prior auctions does not prove it was marketable at those auctions
unfilled odd-lot auction count is not an execution-failure count
future-effective trading-rule amendment must not be back-applied

maturityDecision.reason: Schema/source feasibility and deterministic unit falsification are not prospective receipt completeness. Independent live/prospective capture/replay remains required before L3.

exactNextContinuation: Run isolated prospective receipt capture on independent sessions containing actual mixed-lot parent actions; require deterministic replay and mechanism-state provenance. First readiness review after at least 3 independent sessions, with no automatic maturity promotion.

ruleVersionFirewall.currentEffectiveOddLotRule: 09:10 first call auction, every 5 seconds thereafter under the currently effective rule
ruleVersionFirewall.futureAmendment: TWSE 2026-08-20 amendment changes Article 8 wording to 09:00 start, effective 2026-12-07
ruleVersionFirewall.rule: A mechanism rule is valid only if decisionKnownAt is inside its explicit effective interval. Future amendments cannot be back-applied.

marketabilityLayer.purpose: Do not treat every unfilled call auction as execution failure.
marketabilityLayer.guard: Even PRICE_CROSSING does not prove a broker/execution defect because same-price priority, queue position and available contra volume may still govern the fill.
